recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce a ProdCharacteristic page or ballot-intro entry for this issue; handle any separate DeviceDefinition or ModelInfo remnants only under their own tracker decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-31700 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-I. It asked whether the R4B ballot-intro page would be maintained as version history and, if so, to remove or correctly explain the Product Characteristics/ProdCharacteristic entry from the medication-definition-specific special datatype list because ProdCharacteristic was not used by the listed medication-definition resources and was being removed.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git a24c42b0fc. On the R4B branch that commit removed the prodcharacteristic.html list item from source/ballot-intro.html, leaving MarketingStatus and ProductShelfLife only. The later R5 history migration work added current history content that treats ProdCharacteristic as removed rather than as a new medication-definition datatype.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM 202105 minutes confirm the resolution to not maintain ballot-intro and to migrate content to history. Current source keeps ProdCharacteristic inactive in fhir.ini and records it as removed in R4B. Related ProdCharacteristic/DeviceDefinition issues FHIR-31522, FHIR-30274, and FHIR-26424 are already represented separately on the combined branch and were not duplicated here.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The build-visible ballot/history surfaces no longer present ProdCharacteristic as a medication-definition special datatype, source/history.html records it as removed in R4B, and fhir.ini has only commented ProdCharacteristic entries.
